name: esp32-agent-companion
description: One-word commands for setting up and customizing the ESP32 Agent Companion.

scripts.desktop: npm install --prefix desktop --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.test:session-launch: npm run build --prefix daemon && node --test daemon/dist/test/ghostty-title-probe.test.js daemon/dist/test/session-launch.test.js daemon/dist/test/session-roster.test.js daemon/dist/test/session-focus.test.js daemon/dist/test/device-session-actions.test.js
